topic: Can satellite orbital configurations optimize ML-based QoS by reducing propagation delays for latency-sensitive traffic classes?
consensus_response: Satellite orbital configurations can optimize ML-based QoS by reducing propagation delays through adaptive path selection, considering link characteristics like latency and jitter. Beamforming and antenna technologies enhance link capacity, while Doppler shift and frequency synchronization impact latency and jitter. Adaptive mechanisms mitigate these effects, ensuring optimal QoS.
reference_context: QoS mechanisms like DiffServ and IntServ neglect high fixed latencies in satellite links, impacting QoS in converged networks.
